name: DT Bulk Content Studio
author: Dimitri TONNAIRE

sections.description:
DT Bulk Content Studio gives WordPress editors, agencies, SEO teams and site owners a spreadsheet-style workspace for managing content at scale.

Instead of opening every post, page, product or media item one by one, you can review and edit your content in a fast table view, just like a spreadsheet inside WordPress.

Use it to update titles, slugs, statuses, categories, tags, custom fields, ACF/SCF values, media metadata, SEO fields and WooCommerce product data from one place. You can import spreadsheets, export clean datasets, preview changes, run simulations and roll back recent imports when needed.

It is built for real content operations: SEO cleanup, catalog updates, content audits, migrations, missing field checks, media alt text improvements, WooCommerce product maintenance and recurring editorial workflows.

Main features

  • Edit WordPress content in a spreadsheet-style table.
  • Manage posts, pages, media, custom post types and WooCommerce products.
  • Import and export CSV, TXT, XLS and XLSX files.
  • Preview imports before updating your site.
  • Compare changed values during import previews.
  • Run dry runs before applying sensitive changes.
  • Roll back the last three imports.
  • Keep an import and export journal.
  • Map spreadsheet columns to WordPress fields.
  • Reuse saved column mapping presets.
  • Search and replace across all columns or selected columns.
  • Use regex search and replace with simulation.
  • Find missing values in titles, content, media alt text, SEO fields, ACF fields and more.
  • Edit categories, tags and custom taxonomies in bulk.
  • Create missing taxonomy terms during import when you choose to.
  • Edit custom fields and post meta.
  • Export and import ACF and SCF fields.
  • Edit media alt text, title, caption and description.
  • See where media files are used when available.
  • Replace media files without changing their WordPress attachment ID.
  • Create WebP copies for JPEG and PNG media.
  • Work from public Google Sheet sharing URLs for import previews.
  • Use full-screen mode for large content tables.
  • Resize columns, scroll horizontally, sort and filter data.
  • Save view presets for recurring workflows.
  • Use the interface in French or English.

Typical use cases

  • Update hundreds of page titles, slugs or statuses.
  • Clean missing SEO titles and meta descriptions.
  • Fill missing image alt text across the media library.
  • Export content before a migration or redesign.
  • Import editorial changes prepared in a spreadsheet.
  • Update WooCommerce prices, SKUs, stock values and product metadata.
  • Audit ACF and SCF fields across many content items.
  • Replace media files while keeping existing WordPress links and attachment IDs.
  • Prepare Google Sheets-based content workflows without giving external tools direct write access to WordPress.

WooCommerce support

When WooCommerce is active, DT Bulk Content Studio helps you edit product and variation data in bulk. You can work with fields such as SKU, regular price, sale price, stock, stock status, dimensions, visibility, featured products, related product IDs and variation attributes.

ACF and SCF support

ACF and SCF fields can be exported, imported and edited from the table when available. This helps content teams maintain structured fields without opening each post individually.

Google Sheet support

The plugin supports public Google Sheet sharing URLs for reading and previewing imports. WordPress-to-Sheet workflows are handled through export files that can be opened or imported in Google Sheets. Fully automatic two-way synchronization is intentionally not enabled in simple URL mode, which keeps the workflow simple and easier to review before content is changed.

Languages

DT Bulk Content Studio is designed for French and English WordPress teams.

You can use the admin interface in French or English, making it suitable for bilingual teams, agencies and international WordPress sites.

Import column format

For reliable imports, each spreadsheet column should match a WordPress field, taxonomy, custom field, media field or WooCommerce field.

Common WordPress fields:

  • ID
  • post_title
  • post_content
  • post_status
  • post_type
  • post_name
  • post_excerpt

Taxonomies:

  • tax:category
  • tax:post_tag
  • tax:your_custom_taxonomy

Custom fields:

  • meta:your_meta_key

ACF and SCF fields:

  • acf:your_field_name

Media fields:

  • media:alt
  • media:title
  • media:caption
  • media:description

WooCommerce fields:

  • wc:sku
  • wc:regular_price
  • wc:sale_price
  • wc:stock
  • wc:stock_status
  • wc:variation_attributes
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory or upload the plugin ZIP from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the DT Bulk Content Studio menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Choose the content type you want to manage.
  5. Select your columns, filters and view options.
  6. Start editing, exporting or importing with preview.

CSV and TXT files work for simple workflows. XLS and XLSX files are supported for spreadsheet-based content operations.
sections.faq:
EN: What is DT Bulk Content Studio made for?

DT Bulk Content Studio is made for editors, agencies and site owners who need to update many WordPress items at once: posts, pages, custom post types, media, WooCommerce products, taxonomies, SEO fields, custom fields and ACF/SCF fields.

FR : A quoi sert DT Bulk Content Studio ?

DT Bulk Content Studio sert aux éditeurs, agences et propriétaires de sites qui doivent modifier beaucoup de contenus WordPress en une seule fois : articles, pages, types de contenus personnalisés, médias, produits WooCommerce, taxonomies, champs SEO, champs personnalisés et champs ACF/SCF.

EN: Does the plugin create new posts during import?

Yes. If the selected unique key does not match an existing item, the plugin can create a new post using values such as post_type, post_status and post_title.

FR : Le plugin peut-il créer de nouveaux contenus pendant un import ?

Oui. Si la clé unique choisie ne correspond à aucun élément existant, le plugin peut créer un nouveau contenu avec des valeurs comme post_type, post_status et post_title.

EN: Can an import be undone?

Yes. The plugin stores rollback points for the last three imports.

FR : Peut-on annuler un import ?

Oui. Le plugin conserve des points de retour arrière pour les trois derniers imports.

EN: Is there a preview before importing data?

Yes. You can preview imported rows, check mapped columns, compare existing and incoming values, and run a dry run before applying changes.

FR : Y a-t-il une prévisualisation avant import ?

Oui. Vous pouvez prévisualiser les lignes importées, vérifier le mapping des colonnes, comparer les valeurs existantes et entrantes, et lancer une simulation avant d’appliquer les changements.

EN: Does it support ACF and SCF?

Yes. ACF and SCF fields can be exported and imported. Complex values should be provided as valid JSON.

FR : Le plugin prend-il en charge ACF et SCF ?

Oui. Les champs ACF et SCF peuvent être exportés et importés. Les valeurs complexes doivent être fournies en JSON valide.

EN: Does it support WooCommerce products and variations?

Yes. Product variations can be edited when the product_variation post type is enabled. Variation data can use fields such as post_parent, wc:sku, prices, stock and wc:variation_attributes.

FR : Le plugin prend-il en charge les produits et variations WooCommerce ?

Oui. Les produits et variations peuvent être modifiés lorsque les types de contenus WooCommerce sont activés. Les données peuvent inclure post_parent, wc:sku, les prix, le stock et wc:variation_attributes.

EN: Can I edit SEO metadata?

Yes. The plugin can expose common SEO metadata columns for supported SEO plugins, such as SEO title, meta description, canonical URL, focus keyword and noindex fields when available.

FR : Peut-on modifier les metadonnees SEO ?

Oui. Le plugin peut afficher les colonnes de métadonnées SEO courantes pour les extensions SEO prises en charge, comme le titre SEO, la méta description, l’URL canonique, le mot-clé principal et les champs noindex lorsqu’ils sont disponibles.

EN: Can I edit media information?

Yes. Media items can be listed in the table. You can edit alt text, title, caption and description, identify media usage, replace files without changing the attachment ID and create WebP copies for JPEG and PNG images.

FR : Peut-on modifier les informations des medias ?

Oui. Les médias peuvent être affichés dans le tableau. Vous pouvez modifier le texte alternatif, le titre, la légende et la description, identifier où un média est utilisé, remplacer un fichier sans changer son ID WordPress et créer des copies WebP pour les images JPEG et PNG.

EN: Can it work with Google Sheets?

Yes, with a safe manual workflow. The plugin can read public Google Sheet sharing URLs for import previews. For WordPress-to-Sheet workflows, export the data and import or open it in Google Sheets. Fully automatic two-way synchronization is not enabled in simple URL mode.

FR : Le plugin fonctionne-t-il avec Google Sheets ?

Oui, avec un flux manuel sécurisé. Le plugin peut lire les URL de partage publiques Google Sheets pour prévisualiser les imports. Pour envoyer des données WordPress vers Google Sheets, exportez les données puis importez-les ou ouvrez-les dans Google Sheets. La synchronisation bidirectionnelle entièrement automatique n’est pas activée en mode URL simple.

EN: Can I choose which columns are exported or imported?

Yes. You can select visible columns, map imported columns to WordPress fields, keep mapping presets and ignore columns that should not be synchronized.

FR : Peut-on choisir les colonnes exportees ou importees ?

Oui. Vous pouvez choisir les colonnes visibles, mapper les colonnes importées vers les champs WordPress, conserver des préréglages de mapping et ignorer les colonnes qui ne doivent pas être synchronisées.

EN: Is the table usable for large websites?

Yes. The interface includes pagination, search, filters, advanced column filters, sorting, resizable columns, horizontal scrolling, view presets and a full-screen mode for large tables.

FR : Le tableau est-il utilisable sur de gros sites ?

Oui. L’interface inclut pagination, recherche, filtres, filtres avancés par colonne, tri, colonnes redimensionnables, défilement horizontal, préréglages de vue et mode plein écran pour les grands tableaux.

EN: Can I search and replace content in bulk?

Yes. Search and replace can target all columns or only selected columns. It also supports regex and simulation before applying changes.

FR : Peut-on rechercher et remplacer du contenu en masse ?

Oui. La recherche/remplacement peut cibler toutes les colonnes ou seulement certaines colonnes. Elle prend aussi en charge les regex et la simulation avant application.

EN: Is the plugin available in French and English?

Yes. The admin interface is translation-ready and designed for French and English. The language can also be controlled from the plugin options when needed.

FR : Le plugin est-il disponible en francais et en anglais ?

Oui. L’interface d’administration est prête pour la traduction et pensée pour le français et l’anglais. La langue peut aussi être contrôlée depuis les options du plugin si nécessaire.

EN: Is there a dry run mode?

Yes. Imports and search/replace can be simulated before applying changes.

FR : Existe-t-il un mode simulation ?

Oui. Les imports et les recherches/remplacements peuvent être simulés avant d’appliquer les changements.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Improved spreadsheet table layout for large WordPress content libraries.
  • Added better column resizing, horizontal scrolling and full-screen editing.
  • Improved view presets, filters and search/replace workflows.
  • Added import and export journal improvements.
  • Improved media workflows for alt text, thumbnails, file replacement and WebP copies.
  • Added SEO metadata columns for supported SEO plugins when available.
  • Improved WooCommerce product and variation field coverage.
  • Refined French and English wording across the admin interface and plugin page.

1.0.0

  • First release with spreadsheet editing, imports, exports, rollback, media tools, ACF/SCF support, WooCommerce fields, Google Sheet public URL import preview, import journal and search/replace.

short_description: Bulk edit, import, export and clean WordPress content, media, SEO fields, ACF, SCF and WooCommerce data from one spreadsheet-style workspace.
